description: This file contains utility functions and constants for setting up test resources in the Mattermost server project, including file and directory search, copying, symlinking, and configuration setup.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Searches for a file within predefined search paths, including testdata directories.

methods.name: findDir
methods.description: Finds a directory within predefined search paths, with special handling for the root directory.

methods.name: getTestResourcesToSetup
methods.description: Returns a list of test resource details with full paths resolved.

methods.name: CopyFile
methods.description: Copies a file using the filestore backend.

methods.name: SetupTestResources
methods.description: Sets up temporary test resources by copying or symlinking files and directories, and creates configuration files.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Creates a default configuration JSON file in the specified directory.
